setup.title: Set up your books
setup.intro: Keep your accounts inside Olune instead of connecting Xero, QuickBooks or MYOB. Choose your country and we'll set up the currency, tax rates, chart of accounts and tax return for it.
setup.xeroBlocks: This studio's books are kept in Xero ({org}). To use Olune Books instead, switch on Money → Accounting; it disconnects Xero for you.

country.heading: Where is your studio based?
country.body: Tax rules, currency and the official return form all follow from this.
country.setsTax: {count, plural, one {# {tax} rate} other {# {tax} rates}}, plus zero-rated, exempt and out-of-scope codes
country.setsReturn: {form} prepared from your ledger, ready to file with {authority}
country.setsChart: A chart of {count} accounts made for dance and fitness studios

custom.currencyHint: Three letters, e.g. EUR, USD, MXN.

tax.heading: Are you registered for {tax}?
tax.body: If you're registered with {authority}, we'll calculate the tax on every sale and purchase and prepare your returns.
tax.registeredHint: I charge tax and file returns.
tax.notRegisteredHint: No tax on sales; nothing to file.
tax.threshold: Registration is generally required above {amount} ({label}). Check the current threshold with your tax authority.
tax.anchor: First period of the cycle starts in
tax.pricesIncludeHint: Most studios selling to families quote prices with tax included.

periods.heading: Financial year and start date
periods.body: Olune Books posts your invoices, payments and sales automatically from the start date onwards.
periods.conversionHint: Anything earlier is entered as opening balances.
periods.useSuggested: Start at the beginning of the current tax period ({date})
periods.openingNote: After setup, enter your bank balances and anything owed on the start date as opening balances. Your accountant can give you these figures.

review.heading: Review and create
review.body: Here's what will be created for {studio}. You can rename accounts and add tax rates afterwards.
review.ratesTitle: {count, plural, one {# tax rate} other {# tax rates}}
review.updateProducts: Update {count, plural, one {# product} other {# products}} from 15% to {rate}
review.updateProductsHint: Products still on Olune's default 15% rate will switch to your local standard rate.
review.disclaimer: Tax rules last reviewed {date}. Olune Books prepares your figures; it isn't tax advice, and it doesn't file returns for you. Check anything unusual with your accountant.

errors.customIncomplete: Enter a currency code and standard rate for your country.
errors.taxNumber: That doesn't look like a valid {label}.
errors.taxNumberInvalid: That tax number doesn't look valid.
errors.rate: Enter a tax rate between 0 and 100%.
errors.invalid: Something in the form isn't right. Check it and try again.
errors.xeroConnected: Xero is connected. Disconnect it first: a studio keeps one ledger.

dashboard.title: Books
dashboard.subtitle: {country} · reporting in {currency}
dashboard.syncError: Some transactions couldn't be posted automatically: {message}
dashboard.autoCreated: {count, plural, one {An account was} other {# accounts were}} created for codes your products use ({codes}).
dashboard.returnsDue: {count, plural, one {A {form} is} other {# returns are}} ready to file.
dashboard.notRegistered: You're not registered for {tax}, so there's nothing to file.
dashboard.todoReconcile: {count, plural, =0 {Bank is reconciled} one {Reconcile # bank line} other {Reconcile # bank lines}}
dashboard.noJournals: Nothing posted yet. Journals appear here as invoices, payments and sales come in.
dashboard.todoReviewBills: {count, plural, one {Review # bill in the inbox} other {Review # bills in the inbox}}

sync.done: {posted, plural, =0 {Up to date} one {# entry posted} other {# entries posted}}{errors, plural, =0 {} other {, # need attention}}

accounts.title: Chart of accounts
accounts.subtitle: Every account your transactions post to. System accounts can be renamed but keep their role.
accounts.name: Name
accounts.systemHint: This account is used by automatic posting, so its type is fixed.
accounts.categoryHint: Decides which box of the tax return this rate's amounts land in.
accounts.ratesNote: A rate that has been used can't be changed, so past returns stay reproducible. Archive it and create a new one when a rate changes.

journals.title: Journals
journals.subtitle: Every entry in your books, newest first. Posted entries can't be edited, only voided or reversed.
journals.autoNote: Posted automatically. To change it, edit or void the invoice, bill or sale it came from, and the books follow.
journals.voidBody: If its period is open, the journal is voided. If the period is locked, a reversing entry is posted on the first open day instead.

journalEditor.title: New journal
journalEditor.subtitle: For adjustments your other records don't cover: depreciation, accruals, corrections.
journalEditor.openingSubtitle: Balances on the day before your books start ({date}). Use the figures from your last balance sheet or your accountant.
journalEditor.openingHelp: Debit assets (bank, money owed to you) and credit liabilities (loans, tax owing). Any difference goes to opening balance equity.
journalEditor.taxHelp: Amounts on a taxed line include tax; the tax is split out to the tax account automatically.

bills.title: Bills
bills.subtitle: What the studio owes suppliers: rent, instructors, costumes, licences.
bills.newSubtitle: Enter a supplier invoice. Approve it to post it to your books.
bills.owingSub: {count, plural, one {# bill awaiting payment} other {# bills awaiting payment}}
bills.deleteDraftBody: The draft hasn't been posted, so deleting it doesn't touch your books.
bills.voidBody: Voiding removes the bill from your books (or reverses it if its period is locked). Bills with payments can't be voided.
bills.staffSubmitted: {name} sent this invoice from Olune on {date}. Check the account and tax, then approve it to pay.

bank.title: Bank
bank.subtitle: Import statements and match each line to your books.
bank.noAccounts: There are no bank accounts in your chart.
bank.importBody: Download a CSV from your online banking. Lines you've imported before are skipped automatically.
bank.preview: {count, plural, one {# line ready} other {# lines ready}}
bank.skipped: {count, plural, one {# row skipped} other {# rows skipped}} (rows {rows})
bank.imported: {imported, plural, one {# line imported} other {# lines imported}}{duplicates, plural, =0 {} one {, # already there} other {, # already there}}.
bank.allReconciledBody: Every imported line is reconciled. Import your next statement when it's ready.
bank.daysApart: {days, plural, one {# day apart} other {# days apart}}
bank.stripeHint: Looks like a Stripe payout: code it to Stripe clearing. Card payments already sit there, so this moves the money into your bank.

tax.title: {tax} returns
tax.subtitle: {form}, prepared from your ledger. File it with {authority}, then mark it filed here to lock the period.
tax.notRegisteredBody: Turn on registration in Books settings if that changes.
tax.filedOn: Filed on {date}. Reference: {reference}. This period is locked.
tax.notEndedReason: You can mark a return filed once its period has ended.
tax.ledgerCheck: Ledger check: output tax {output}, input tax {input}
tax.nothing: No taxable transactions in this period.
tax.fileBody: Only do this once you've filed the return for {start} to {end} with the tax authority.
tax.fileSettlement: Your output and input tax balances will be moved into the settlement account, which then shows what you owe.
tax.filingReferenceHint: The confirmation or receipt number you were given. Optional.
tax.fileWarning: Filing locks the period: nothing dated on or before the period end can be posted, edited or voided until the lock date is moved.

reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: Financial statements straight from your ledger. Export to CSV for your accountant.
reports.outOfBalance: The balance sheet is out by {amount}. Check recent manual journals.
reports.exportPackHint: This financial year’s statements, trial balance, aged balances and general ledger in one file for your accountant

cashFlow.depreciationOffset: Less depreciation already in fixed assets
cashFlow.unexplained: Cash movements are out by {amount}. Check recent manual journals.

suppliers.empty: No approved bills in this period.

settings.title: Books settings
settings.subtitle: Set up for {country}
settings.conversionHint: Fixed at setup. Earlier activity belongs in opening balances.
settings.lockHint: Nothing on or before this date can change. Set automatically when you file a return.
settings.lockChangeWarning: Moving the lock date reopens filed periods. Only do this to amend a return.
settings.autoPost: Post invoices, payments, refunds and sales automatically
settings.autoPostHint: Turn off only if you'd rather enter everything as journals yourself.
settings.packBody: Set up for {country}, reporting in {currency}. Rules last reviewed {date}.

errors.invalid: Something in the form isn't right. Check it and try again.
errors.notSetUp: Olune Books isn't set up for this studio.
errors.notFound: That record no longer exists or has already changed.
errors.duplicateContact: There's already a supplier with that name.
errors.debitAndCredit: A line can be a debit or a credit, not both.
errors.negativeAmount: Amounts can't be negative; use the other column.
errors.twoLines: A journal needs at least two lines.
errors.unbalanced: Debits and credits must be equal.
errors.lockedDate: The books are locked up to {date}. Choose a later date.
errors.voidAtSource: This entry was posted automatically. Change or void the invoice, bill or sale it came from instead.
errors.billLocked: Only draft bills can be edited.
errors.billHasPayments: This bill has payments. Remove them before voiding.
errors.billNoLines: Add at least one line with an amount.
errors.billLineIncomplete: Every line needs a description, an account and a quantity.
errors.overpayment: That's more than is outstanding on the bill.
errors.csvEmpty: That file has no rows to import.
errors.alreadyFiled: That return has already been filed.
errors.taxNumber: That tax number doesn't look valid.
errors.xeroConnected: This studio's books are kept in Xero. Switch on Money → Accounting first.
errors.tooManyFiles: Upload up to 10 files at a time.
errors.attachmentType: Upload a PDF or a photo (PNG, JPEG, WebP or HEIC).
errors.uploadFailed: The upload didn’t finish. Check your connection and try again.
errors.uploadsNotConfigured: Document uploads aren’t available on this deployment yet.
errors.uploadMissing: We couldn’t find the uploaded file. Try uploading it again.
errors.noAttachment: This bill has no document to read.
errors.couldNotRead: The document couldn’t be read. Fill the bill in from it by hand.

inbox.dropTitle: Drop supplier invoices here, or click to choose
inbox.dropHint: PDFs or photos, up to 10 at a time. Each becomes a draft bill with the document attached, ready for you to fill in and approve.
inbox.dropHintAi: PDFs or photos, up to 10 at a time. We read the supplier, dates, amounts and tax into a draft bill for you to check and approve.
inbox.noAiKey: To have invoices read for you, add an Anthropic or OpenAI key.
inbox.removeConfirm: Remove this document from the bill?
inbox.previewUnavailable: This file can’t be previewed here.
inbox.readNotice: Filled in from the attached document. Check each line against it before you approve.
inbox.notReadNotice: The document couldn’t be read automatically. Use “Read again”, or fill the bill in from it.
inbox.noAiNotice: Fill the bill in from the document beside it. Add an AI key in Settings → Connections to have invoices read for you.

warnings.notInvoice: This doesn’t look like an invoice or receipt.
warnings.foreignCurrency: The document is in another currency. Enter the amounts in your books’ currency.
warnings.linesDontAddUp: The lines don’t add up to the document’s total.
warnings.noAmounts: No amounts were found. Add the lines by hand.
